description: A credit committee chair must decide whether to renew a logistics company's revolving credit line and finalize the commitment, collateral, reporting, and draw conditions, with input from risk, relationship coverage, and compliance.

shared_context.S1: The logistics company is requesting renewal of its $15,000,000 revolving credit line for another year.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the binding renewal decision.
shared_context.S3: The borrower has made all scheduled interest and principal payments during the current facility term.
shared_context.S4: The committee's normal pre-decision process is for risk, relationship coverage, and compliance to report any file updates before the chair signs the renewal.

PF1.text: While reviewing the borrowing-base file this week, Victor found $3,000,000 of affiliate receivables that are ineligible under policy; the resulting eligible base supports a renewed commitment of exactly $12,000,000, and the renewal must include a monthly borrowing-base certificate. His revised calculation is not yet attached to the committee file.

PF2.text: The borrower confirmed this morning that it will pledge a $1,500,000 first-ranking deposit as additional collateral for the renewal, making the conditional renewal executable; Maya has the signed term sheet but it has not yet been uploaded.

PF3.text: Jonas received a compliance memo yesterday showing that a recent ownership change at the borrower's guarantor requires enhanced due diligence before any draw and a refreshed beneficial-ownership certification within 5 business days; the memo has not yet been logged in the renewal checklist.

acceptance_conditions: The revolving line must be renewed at exactly $12,000,000.
The renewal must require exactly $1,500,000 of deposit collateral.
A monthly borrowing-base certificate must be attached as a renewal condition.
Enhanced due diligence must be completed before any draw.
The refreshed beneficial-ownership certification must be required within 5 business days.
The renewal must be approved conditionally rather than declined.

decisive_facts.why: Without PF1, the clean payment record supports renewing the requested $15,000,000 without a borrowing-base certificate; PF1 changes renewed_commitment_usd to exactly 12000000 and requires monthly_borrowing_base_certificate to be true.
Without PF2, the committee has no confirmed additional collateral and may decline rather than renew; PF2 changes deposit_collateral_usd to exactly 1500000 and makes line_renewed true feasible.

Without PF3, the renewal can omit enhanced due diligence before draw and the certification deadline; PF3 changes enhanced_due_diligence_before_draw to true and sets beneficial_ownership_certification_deadline_days to exactly 5.
